headline: Sale listings flood the market, but there are hardly any buyers: difficult times await property owners
summary: A representative survey shows the share of adults planning to buy property in Hungary in the next year fell to 7.3% from 10.3%. Sellers now outnumber prospective buyers for the first time in a year.
why: Household property demand is a key driver of residential prices and mortgage lending in Hungary. Shifts in buyer intentions signal changes in housing market activity.
